title: Why “league of legends” is trending in FR: 500+ searches, the facts (August 21, 2026)
description: “league of legends” is trending in FR with 500+ searches reported by Google. The verified coverage behind the spike, from Eurogamer and 2 more.

sections.heading: What is trending: “league of legends”
paragraphs: “league of legends” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for FR (snapshot taken 2026-08-21T13:10:26+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 500 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Eurogamer, GameTyrant, Riot Games. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “2XKO Active Development Will End in December 2026” — Riot Games
“Riot Games to end LoL fighting game 2XK0's development and issue refunds, less than a year since launch” — Eurogamer
“2XKO's Demise Is Disappointing But Not Shocking” — GameTyrant

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Fri, 21 Aug 2026 05:00:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-21T13:10:26+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-21T13:11:31+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from Eurogamer, GameTyrant, Riot Games. faq.q: How many people searched for “league of legends”?
faq.a: Google reports at least 500 searches in FR as of the feed snapshot. This is a published lower bound, not an exact count.
This snapshot covers FR. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
